sentences.text:
Sections 498A/325/306/34 Of The Indian ... vs In Re: Gita Mandal
on 12 August, 2024
Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen 12.08.2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code  Criminal Procedure read with Section 482 of the BNSS, in connection with  Gangarampur Police Station Case No. 468 of 2023 dated 06.10.2023 under Sections 498A/325/306/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
 And  In Re: Gita Mandal  Petitioner  Mr. Kaushik Chaudhruy  Ms. Busra Khatun  For the Petitioner  Mr. Anand Keshari  Ms. Suparna Chatterjee  For the State  1.
The learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is 45% disabled and the allegations are false, baseless and frivolous.

2. The learned Counsel appearing on behalf the State, in opposing the prayer for anticipatory bail,
has referred to the statement of the son of the victim.

3. Considering the materials available in the case dairy and the statement of the son of the petitioner, who appears to have witnessed administration of poison by the stepfather and the present petitioner and also having regard to the fact that, prima facie, there are incriminating materials against the petitioner, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the present petitioner.
4.
Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected.
